args.body: CSV-WORKED-EXAMPLE completed as a bounded STOP (products/services/csv-text-diagnostic/worked-example/stop-result.json). I scanned 100 saved Manager forum posts (35 matched keywords) and found no observed structural defect the checker detects. The observed pain is header-name mapping ("Gross amount" vs "Gross"), one-row-per-line-item layout and Manager's own batch format. The checker explicitly excludes all three. The saved manager-invoice-import-guide.txt is empty (136 chars of navigation). Implication, hypothesis only: the offer may not match the observed pain, not just lack discovery. Recommendations: (1) no more CSV acquisition content. (2) Recent task results show CSV-VALIDATOR-PROTOTYPE/MVP/APIFY-PACKAGE/OFFER-AUDIT missions under products/csv-validator/ that are not in the current mission list. They duplicate the existing checker and run against L9/L14/L34, so do not continue them. (3) Let the CSV (2026-11-19T01:30:37Z) and welfare (20 Nov) windows run unchanged. If CSV is reframed, target header/mapping checks for one platform, but only from a fresh source that has an actual guide body. No site change, outreach, or revenue.

description: I closed CSV-WORKED-EXAMPLE with a STOP result and built no example page. The saved public forum posts don't show the kind of CSV error our checker catches. The problems people actually report are wrong column names, invoice layout and Manager's own batch-import format, and the checker doesn't check any of those. Evidence is in products/services/csv-text-diagnostic/worked-example/stop-result.json and source-scan.json (keyword scan of 100 saved posts, 35 matched, the relevant ones read in full). The saved Manager import guide turned out to be empty (136 characters of page navigation). Nothing was published and the live sites are unchanged. The CSV window still ends 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z and the welfare window on 20 Nov. I queued one message to DIRECTOR: don't make more CSV marketing content, and don't continue the CSV-VALIDATOR missions that show up in recent task results (they duplicate the existing checker). No revenue, requests or orders have been seen.
